aboutMe.name: Ming-Hsuan
aboutMe.title: Data Science | Natural Hazards | Content Creation
aboutMe.description: Science is not just knowing. It's discovering.

story.heading: Curiosity is everything 💡
paragraphs: I'm a scientist working in earth science, and a content creator exploring the world.
For the past few years I have studied earthquakes and natural hazards, using data to understand phenomena that resist prediction.
Somewhere in the research, I came to see this:
**What matters more than knowing an answer is noticing a question, and starting to look for one.**
So now I want to bring the way a researcher sees the world to more people.
Faced with a hard problem, how do we begin?
What makes an answer worth believing? What is the evidence? And when the evidence runs short, what can we still know?
From earthquakes and natural hazards to the things we take for granted in everyday life,
**all of it is worth asking again: why?**

story.heading: Travel, books, films, and overthinking 💭
paragraphs: Outside the research, I like to travel, read, watch films, and think about whatever life puts in front of me.
Living in Germany now, I keep meeting new questions — in different places, different books, different stories.
Since 2025 I have been turning those observations into videos and episodes on YouTube, sharing the world as I see it.
Sometimes it is science, sometimes a trip, sometimes a book or a film — sometimes just a question that turns up out of nowhere.
I don't know what I will find next.

experience.title: Data Science Projects (Career Transition)
descriptions: **Near-Fault Pulse Database:** Built an automated Python pipeline that pulls earthquake records from global archives, detects damaging velocity pulses and updates a live interactive map every 6 hours; it reproduces 25 of 27 published results and is backed by 70 automated tests.
**AI-assisted Development:** Built the pipeline with AI coding agents, which fetch the data and run quality checks on a scheduled pipeline.
**Career Transition:** Moving from research to industry through portfolio projects in seismic hazard data science, published on this site.

experience.title: Guest Researcher (part-time)
descriptions: **Research:** Co-authored peer-reviewed publications on earthquake ground motion and seismic hazard.
**Training:** In parallel, completed an intensive AI Software Development course (WBS Coding School, 2026).

experience.title: Scientific Researcher
descriptions: **Continental-scale Data Pipeline:** Built a Python and SQL pipeline that reduced ~52 million raw seismic waveforms from ~1,600 stations in Germany, Italy, France and Poland to 220,000 quality-controlled spectra and a catalogue of 6,135 characterised earthquakes.

**Hazard Modelling:** Developed and validated physics-based and statistical models of earthquake sources and ground-motion scaling, used to calibrate ground-motion simulations for European seismic hazard assessment.

**Signal Processing:** Designed workflows for multi-network strong-motion data from Taiwan, Japan, New Zealand, Türkiye and Europe, showing that magnitude-based models miss strong site-to-site variability in damaging near-fault ground motion.
**Communication & Publications:** Communicated hazard modelling results to non-specialist and policy audiences, and published 7 peer-reviewed papers, 4 as first author.

experience.title: Research Intern
descriptions: **Hazard Model Inputs:** Compiled, cleaned and harmonised earthquake and site-condition data for Italy and Switzerland as input to a site-model update for Impact Forecasting's seismic hazard and risk models.
**Catastrophe Modelling:** Worked with model developers to understand the end-to-end catastrophe-modelling workflow, from hazard and site inputs to Aon's internal modelling systems.

experience.title: Research Assistant
descriptions: **Site Risk Assessment:** Delivered seismic site risk assessments to government agencies for a spent nuclear fuel disposal site, integrating evidence from geologists, seismologists and engineering seismologists.
**Ground-motion Simulation:** Ran broadband ground-motion simulations to estimate earthquake source parameters for the site evaluation, validated against recorded seismic data (published 2021).
**Taiwan Earthquake Model:** Simulated historical earthquakes for the Taiwan Earthquake Model and supported model and data exchange with teams in Japan and New Zealand.
